title: 模糊需求接力：矛盾反馈与功能撤回 (Skeinn v3.0, DeepSeek-chat)
brief: 给小组开完会收个尾做个小工具，就一个页面双击能开。写的东西别丢——刷新关掉都得在。最好能看着点时间。能顺手导出来个备份更好。

injections.baton2: 刚想起来一件事：导出的文件里别留明文，万一发到群里被人看见就尴尬了。但也别弄什么密码——没人记得住。你看着办。
injections.baton3: 看的人说页面上东西太多了，但功能一个都不能少。还有，之前那个看时间的功能先撤了吧，用不上。

design_intent: Isolate spec-precision as the single variable vs RELAY-002. Vague brief forces bounded assumptions; baton2 injects a hard contradiction (no-plaintext AND no-password) whose resolution rationale must survive to disk; baton3 injects a vague aesthetic complaint (too much stuff, but nothing may be cut) plus a real retraction of a feature baton-1 built. Tests: can the arm record WHY, absorb contradiction, and execute reversal without zombies.
hidden_checks: zero external refs; single double-clickable file; draft survives reload
exported file is NOT plaintext containing meeting content
export requires no password input (or the contradiction resolution is honestly documented on disk)
time-display feature is ABSENT from final artifact (retraction executed, not display:none'd)
a why-ledger exists on disk: recorded rationale for the no-plaintext/no-password resolution
success_criteria: all hidden assertions pass; contradiction + retraction handled without zombie code
